page.layout: Two parallel columns of dictionary entries, with Hebrew headwords and Latin glosses. Left column: lines from the top to the foot, ending in "bi-" at the column foot. Right column: continues the entry "bi" at the top, then a centred section heading "א ת", then entries to the foot. Running heads at the top left and right. Page number 37 at the top right. Catchword and signature at the foot of the right column.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and forms are transcribed from the scan with niqqud approximated; forms marked [?] are doubtful. The first line of the right column continues the entry "bibam ... bi-" from the left column. The entry "אַשְׁרֵי" and the Hebrew forms in the left column are the least certain. The catchword "אִתְבּוֹנֵן" stands at the foot of the right column, and the signature "E 3" at the left foot.
